title.narrative: Multitranche Financing Facility (MFF) - Malolos-Clark Railway Project-Tranche 1

description.narrative: The project will support the construction of two sections, totaling 53.1 kilometers (km), of the North-South Commuter Railway (NSCR), a 163 km suburban railway network connecting the regional center of Clark in Central Luzon with Metro Manila and Calamba, Laguna. The Malolos-Clark Railway Project comprises: (i) Malolos-Clark section (51.2 km) from Malolos to Clark and Clark International Airport, and (ii) Blumentritt extension (1.9 km) connecting Solis and Blumentritt stations in Metro Manila District I (City of Manila). Both sections are part of the NSCR and extensions of the Tutuban-Solis-Malolos section financed by the Japan International Cooperation Agency. The NSCR will be completed during 2022-2025 as an integrated 163 km dedicated suburban passenger railway system comprising four sections: (i) Tutuban-Solis-Malolos, (ii) Malolos-Clark-Clark International Airport, (iii) Solis-Blumentritt-Calamba, and (iv) Clark-New Clark City. The project will provide affordable, reliable, and safe public transport; reduce greenhouse gas emissions; and contribute to cutting travel time from Metro Manila to Clark from 2-3 hours (by bus) to less than 1 hour by rail.

As of October 2025, all 6 civil works contract packages financed under the project are under implementation.
The two contract packages (CP-N-04 and CP-N-05) for construction of the main line and depot in Clark were signed on 1 August 2020. CP N-04 contractor commenced civil works on 30 October 2020 while CP N-05 contractor commenced civil works on 28 October 2020.
The three contract packages (CP-N-01 to CP-N-03) for construction of the main line between Malolos and Clark were signed on 8 October 2020. Contractors commenced civil works on 7 December 2020.
The last contract package (CP S-01) for construction of the main line and station in Bluementritt was signed on 13 July 2023. Instruction to commence was issued on 10 November 2023 effective 14 November 2023.
Current progress of the civil works of each package achieved at the end of September 2025 (based on the latest progress report [September 2025], submitted to ADB on 10 October 2025 by the Engineer) is 63.40% for CP N-01, 48.30% (CP N-02), 38.30% (CP N-03), 69.20% (CP N-04), 95.50% (CP N-05), and 6.46% (CP S-01). The total physical progress is at 53.53%.

Recruitment of a consulting firm was completed on 1 October 2020 when the contract between ADB and the consulting firm was signed. Consulting firm commenced services on 3 November 2020. Services were completed on 3 September 2023.
An individual Independent Evaluation Expert was engaged with services commenced on 1 February 2021.
The TA Consultant's Report has been disclosed and accessible through this link: https://www.adb.org/projects/documents/phi-52083-007-tacr
The TA's Completion Report has been disclosed and accessible through this link: https://www.adb.org/projects/documents/phi-52083-007-tcr
The Department of Finance in a letter dated 28 Jun 2024 requested ADB's approval for a provisional 3 month loan closing date extension to enable DOTr to finalize and comply with the requirements of NEDA ICC. ADB provided no objection to the provisional extension covering 1 July 2024 to 30 September 2024 period.
A letter from the Department of Finance (DOF) dated 14 November 2024 requested for further extension of tranche 1's closing date from 30 September 2024 to 31 December 2025, as well as the extension of the multitranche financing facility's availability period from 31 December 2024 to 31 December 2028, and combiniing the originally planned tranche 2 of $1,000 million, and tranche 3 of $450 million into a single tranche 2 of $1,450 million. ADB approved the requested on 3 December 2024.
DOF, in a letter dated 6 March 2025 requested the reallocation of the entire loan proceeds equivalent to $15.0 million allocated to category 1201-institutional development component (output 2) to category 0301-works (output 1). ADB on 10 March 2025 approved the request. In a letter dated 21 March 2025 ADB sent to DOF the amendment to Loan Agreement dated 11 July 2019 for signing by DOF. DOF signed the amendment document on 22 April 2025. Data Source: Malolos-Clark Railway's passenger records
